name: prism-mcp
stderr:
Usage: prism [options] [command]

MCP Context Router + Agent Observability

Options:
  -V, --version        output the version number
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  start [options]      Start the Prism MCP proxy
  init [options]       Generate a prism.toml config file
  benchmark [options]  Show token savings with vs without Prism
  status               Show Prism status
  help [command]       display help for command
